info.title: Spinikus API
info.description:
The API of a Spinikus instance, as the dashboard and the `spinikus` CLI use it.

Callers authenticate with an API token, `Authorization: Bearer spk_…` (from `POST /api/v1/login` or the dashboard's API tokens page). Errors are RFC 9457 problem details whose `code` is stable. Single resources carry their revision as an `ETag`, and updates need it back in `If-Match`. Lists are cursor pages: pass a page's `next_cursor` as `after` for the next one.

get.summary: Opens a terminal in the service's running container, as a WebSocket.
get.description: Opens a terminal in the service's running container, as a WebSocket. Binary messages are the terminal's bytes, both ways; the client sends `{"type":"resize","rows","columns"}` as text when its window changes, and the server ends with `{"type":"exit","code"}` or `{"type":"error","message"}` before closing. Closing the socket closes the command's input. Environment admins only; each terminal is recorded in the audit log.

parameters.description: The deployment whose container to open it in; the live one by default.

The command to run, as a JSON array of strings, such as `["psql","-U","app"]`; the
container's shell (bash, else sh) by default.

parameters.description: The terminal's size in characters; 24 by 80 by default.

get.summary: The deployment's log so far (the clone, build, pull and health check), as plain text.

Follows the deployment as server-sent events: `log` events (a line each, with the byte offset after it as the event ID), a `status` event first and on every change, and `end` (with the final status) once it is live or has finished.
get.description: Follows the deployment as server-sent events: `log` events (a line each, with the byte offset after it as the event ID), a `status` event first and on every change, and `end` (with the final status) once it is live or has finished. `Last-Event-ID` resumes after that offset.
